pages.title: Accomplishments - Jim Justice for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Largest Tax Cut in State History
Enacted the largest state tax cut in state history, which will return over $750 million to hardworking West Virginians through income tax cuts, car tax rebates, and small business property tax rebates.
## A Pro-Life Champion
West Virginians for Life honored and recognized Governor Justice for signing more pro-life bills into law than any governor in state history, including bold legislation stopping nearly all abortions in West Virginia. He provided $ 1 million in funding for pregnancy resource centers and increased the adoption tax credit.
## Second Amendment
Governor Justice has hunted and fished all his life and strongly supports the Second Amendment. The National Rifle Association said he has done more to protect the Second Amendment than any Governor in recent history. Most recently, Justice signed the Campus Self-Defense Act allowing law-abiding gun owners with concealed carry permits to take firearms onto public college and university campuses.
## Conservative Courts and Judges
Appointed a rock-solid conservative majority to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia, created the Intermediate Court of Appeals of West Virginia to bring fairness to our legal system, and appointed a conservative majority to the new court.
## West Virginia is a Tourism Destination
Launched the “Almost Heaven” tourism campaign to showcase West Virginia, invested hundreds of millions of dollars to upgrade state parks and recreation areas, and supported the New River Gorge National Park, making West Virginia a top vacation spot.
## Teachers, School Personnel, and State Employee Raises
Raised the salaries for teachers, school service personnel, state employees, and West Virginia State Police numerous times.
## Taking Care of West Virginians
No West Virginian should go hungry. Governor Justice has prioritized millions annually in funding for food banks across West Virginia, including $10 million to establish the Posey Perry Emergency Food Bank Fund and 43 new meal delivery vehicles for the Meals on Wheels program.
## Supporting Our Veterans
As a strong supporter of our veterans, Governor Justice exempted military retirement income from state income tax, enacted a property tax rebate for disabled military veterans, awarded $5.5 million for the veteran’s nursing home in Clarksburg, funded 25 vans to transport disabled or injured veterans to medical appointments, and dedicated the largest Gold Star Families Memorial Monument in the world at the State Capitol Complex.
## Supporting Coal, Oil, and Natural Gas
Cut the severance tax on coal, oil, and natural gas in West Virginia to encourage the development and utilization of more natural resources in West Virginia.
## Roads to Prosperity
Championed the Roads to Prosperity program, which transformed West Virginia’s roads, highways, and bridges by investing billions of dollars in new highway projects and repairs across West Virginia.
## Record Budget Surpluses
After inheriting a $500 million budget deficit, Governor Jim Justice has led the state to consistently record-setting billion-dollar budget surpluses by using his lifelong experience as a businessman to make West Virginia more business-friendly.
## Jobs & Hope for West Virginians
Created the Jobs and Hope West Virginia Program, which offers support through a statewide collaboration of agencies that provide West Virginians in recovery the opportunity to obtain career training and secure meaningful employment.
## Competing on the World Stage
West Virginia is finally competing on the world stage and recruiting world-class companies to our state, as shown in several major economic development announcements, including Nucor Steel, Klockner Pentaplast, Proctor & Gamble, Blue Rock Manufacturing, Speedway Motors, Sheetz, Clearway Energy Group, North American Millwright, Clorox, Infor, Hino, West Virginia Methanol, TeMa, CS Global Group, and Commercial Metals Company, Omnis Building Technologies, Clean Vision Corporation, to name just a few.
## Communities in Schools
Started and expanded the Communities In Schools program to reach tens of thousands of students across West Virginia. The initiative forges community partnerships and brings resources into schools to help remove barriers to student learning to keep all students in school and ultimately graduating.
## Cleaning Up Our Communities
Worked with our counties and cities to deploy millions to remove blighted, abandoned, and dilapidated structures across West Virginia to make our communities safer, increase property values, and attract investment.
## Billion Dollar Broadband Expansion
Announced nearly $1 billion state investment in major broadband improvements, connecting hundreds of thousands of West Virginia homes to world-class broadband connectivity over the next decade.
## Elect Jim Justice to Fight for West Virginia in the Senate

## Governor Jim Justice Issues Statement on U.S. Senator Joe Manchin’s Political Announcement
November 9, 2023
Charleston, W.Va. – Today, Governor Jim Justice issued the following statement regarding U.S. Senator Joe Manchin’s political announcement.
“Senator Joe Manchin and I have not always agreed on policy and politics, but we’re both lifelong West Virginians who love this state beyond belief, and I respect and thank him for his many years of public service,” said Governor Jim Justice.
To learn more about Governor Jim Justice’s campaign for U.S. Senate visit www.jimjusticewv.com.
## Elect Jim Justice to Fight for West Virginia in the Senate

“Senator Joe Manchin and I have not always agreed on policy and politics, but we’re both lifelong West Virginians who love this state beyond belief, and I respect and thank him for his many years of public service,” said Governor Jim Justice.

pages.title: STRENGTHEN THE BORDER - Jim Justice
pages.text:
## STRENGTHEN THE BORDER
President Biden’s border policies are a total disaster. Not only has Biden created a humanitarian crisis, but he has jeopardized Americans’ health, safety, and jobs with a lawless situation on our border with Mexico. Women and children are being trafficked and abused on their way to the U.S., and deadly drugs are being smuggled into our communities and killing our loved ones at alarming rates.
West Virginia is an Appalachian state with a southern border crisis. Despite the great strides we’ve made together to combat the opioid crisis in our state, the crisis won’t end until we secure our border and stem the flow of dangerous drugs like fentanyl.
Governor Justice was proud to join 26 Republican Governors in fighting against the border chaos with commonsense policies at the state level. But to make meaningful change, we need action at the federal level.
Career politicians in both parties have played politics and created this mess, and all Americans are paying the price. It’s time for Washington to face the consequences of their failed policies and to restore safety in our communities.
Governor Justice will fight to secure the border, build the wall, and return to Trump-era policies that drastically curtailed the flood of illegal immigrants and drugs across our southern border. As your Senator, Jim Justice will make border security a top priority.
## Support Jim Justice’s Campaign for Senate

pages.title: CONSERVATIVE JUDGES - Jim Justice for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## CONSERVATIVE JUDGES
Governor Justice believes in limited government that works for the people, not the other way around. He is proud to have appointed rock-solid conservative judges to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia.
In the Senate, Jim Justice will fight to confirm judges at the federal level who will uphold our Constitution and the rule of law.
Now, more than ever, we need federal judges who reflect our values, respect our Constitution and will stop legislating radical policies from the bench that Democrats can’t get through Congress.
## Support Jim Justice’s Campaign for Senate

pages.title: CRIME, LAW, AND ORDER - Jim Justice
pages.text:
## CRIME, LAW, AND ORDER
Democrats’ radical soft-on-crime policies have led to a spike in crime nationwide. Deadly drugs are flowing into our neighborhoods, and increased violent crime has led businesses to close. It’s no wonder many Americans don’t feel safe in their communities – and that’s not right.
West Virginia is a law-and-order state. Governor Justice’s top priority is to protect West Virginians, and the best way to do that is by supporting our men and women in law enforcement, not defunding the police.
Governor Justice is proud to have supported more pay for law enforcement in West Virginia and will always have their backs. Backing the blue means ensuring officers have what they need to do their jobs and keep us safe.
Protecting West Virginians also means tackling the root causes of crime and supporting those struggling with addiction. As Governor, Jim Justice was proud to oversee measures to crack down on drug trafficking, address substance abuse prevention and treatment, and provide those in recovery with the opportunity to obtain career training and secure meaningful employment. It’s time lawmakers act to stop drugs from pouring in across our border and expand access to mental health and substance abuse care.
## Support Jim Justice’s Campaign for Senate

pages.title: ECONOMY & JOBS - Jim Justice for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## ECONOMY & JOBS
President Biden and the radical left’s reckless economic policies are hurting hardworking Americans and making it difficult to make ends meet. We cannot keep heading in the same direction. Hardworking West Virginians deserve to keep more of their money and be able to find good paying jobs.
Governor Justice has a track record of delivering more good jobs, growing our economy, lowering taxes, attracting more investment, and bringing West Virginia’s unemployment rate to record lows. Jim Justice has led the charge for the largest tax cuts in state history, and defended West Virginia jobs, energy, and values.
As your Senator, Jim Justice will stand up to Biden and the radical left and continue to fight for the middle class. In Washington, Justice will fight for a better future for West Virginia by slashing burdensome regulations, supporting small businesses, and rewarding hard work, not punishing it.
America has a tremendous opportunity with the innovation and technology around artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and cryptocurrencies. Jim Justice believes we must ensure a digital market structure that protects Americans from bad actors but allows these innovators to flourish and create new, exciting technology, jobs, and opportunities. He opposes a central bank digital currency that would permit the federal government to surveil and restrict Americans’ financial transactions. He supports a clear regulatory framework for these exciting digital assets, allowing entrepreneurs to innovate, flourish, create jobs, and achieve their full potential.
From record inflation to record gas prices, the Democrats’ anti-energy and anti-American policies have also made clear that we must decrease our reliance on foreign adversaries. To build a secure economy and reduce prices, we must increase American energy independence – which includes West Virginia coal, natural gas, and oil.
## Support Jim Justice’s Campaign for Senate

pages.title: EDUCATION - Jim Justice for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## EDUCATION
The Democrats’ disastrous COVID policies and obsession with wokeness have led to a generation of young people struggling in school. Our kids are our future. These policies must stop.
We must return to the basics like reading, writing, and math instead of wasting valuable resources and time on divisive and controversial political indoctrination. We must let kids be kids and keep politics out of the classroom.
We must also ensure all our schools have the resources to properly teach our children and prepare them for careers in the 21st century.
As Governor, Jim Justice made education West Virginia’s centerpiece and was proud to have increased teacher and school service personnel pay four times and expanded access to computer science education for all West Virginia students. In addition, he expanded school choice with more charter schools and micro-schools and signed legislation to create the Hope Scholarship so parents and children can choose the education path that best meets their needs.
In the Senate, he will work to restore local control of education, cut down the federal education bureaucracy, and promote funding for career and technical education.
## Support Jim Justice’s Campaign for Senate
